tools.name: bubble_emotes_search
tools.description: Find enabled, reviewed Unicode emoji by intended meaning. Read usage, avoid rules and examples; judge context, negation, quotation and emotional changes. Pictures are not supported. Use a selected emoji directly in pet_say.script; no other fields or host patches are needed.

summary.zh: 按表达意图检索已审核的表情。
summary.en: Searches reviewed emotes by intended meaning.

tools.name: bubble_emotes_prepare
tools.description: Read one enabled, reviewed Unicode emoji and its usage. Put the emoji character itself in the standard pet_say.script, alone or beside words. Body expressions are optional script-marker suggestions, not confirmed synchronization. No images, rich presentation, renderer registration or special emoji fields are supported.

summary.zh: 读取普通emoji及其使用说明。
summary.en: Reads a Unicode emoji and its usage.

prompts.title: 使用说明
